classification: Exact source, parameter and historical-input references for six terminal controllers. This registry creates no numerical result.

retained_whole_files_contract.restore_each_exact_version: git show <restore_commit>:<path>; require bytes, Git blob SHA and SHA-256 in the record.

actual_entry_sources.unknown_field_scope: Per historical source version Git blob SHA and bytes were not separately supplied by the actual controller records; use the exact recorded commit:path and actual source SHA. Current source files are not presumed byte-identical.
actual_entry_sources.recovery: git show <actual_checkout_commit>:<path_table[path_table_index]>; the actual SHA-256 remains authoritative.

actual_queue_versions.recovery: git show <actual_path_commit>:<path_table[path_table_index]>; retain every original queue field, full step object, summary map, scope and cleanup/protection list. A current rewritten or archived queue is an additional complete-argument reference, not a substitute for this exact whole historical queue.

historical_scientific_input.role: Genuine historical accepted .99 input, restored by the retained source recipes; neither an inferred final state nor a new certificate.
historical_scientific_input.metadata_source: Complete historical topic tree at 60321451c058c6a51da58c37ae5ec6f2d1145f74; metadata only, no gzip body read.
